title: GA4GH IO Profile Workflow Keywords
description: Keywords of the top level of an IO schema that tie it to one version of a workflow or tool in a TRS and to the engine that runs it. They are allowed only at the top level.

workflow.description: The workflow or tool version that the IO schema describes, and the engine binding: the TRS identifiers, the descriptor type, the checksum of the primary descriptor and the entry point.

trs_tool_id.description: The id of the tool in the TRS (Tool.id).

trs_version_id.description: The id of the tool version in the TRS (ToolVersion.id).

descriptor_type.description: The TRS descriptor type of the workflow or tool, which is also the WES workflow_type. An IO schema describes one descriptor type.

descriptor_type_version.description: The version of the workflow language (e.g., 1.1 for WDL, DSL2 for Nextflow, v1.2 for CWL), as listed in the descriptor_type_version of the TRS tool version; the WES workflow_type_version.

primary_descriptor_path.description: The path of the primary descriptor (TRS file type PRIMARY_DESCRIPTOR), relative to the root of the tool version's files, as listed by TRS.

checksum.description: Checksums of the primary descriptor, in the format of TRS checksums.
The hex-encoded checksum of the bytes of the primary descriptor.

type.description: The checksum algorithm, as in TRS: its Hash Name String in the GA4GH Checksum Hash Algorithm Registry (e.g., sha-256), which includes the IANA names.

entry_point.description: The entry point of the engine: the name of the WDL workflow (or of the task, for a document with a single task and no workflow), the Nextflow workflow run with -entry, or the CWL process (e.g., #main in a packed document). Required for WDL, which qualifies the names of inputs with it.
